clauses.reason: The order exempts Miss Roberta L. Lindsey, administrative officer, Division of Loans and Currency, Bureau of the Public Debt, Treasury Department, from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, and fixes the period in its own words: "for a period of one year ending December 31, 1941". The end is recorded as December 31, 1941 (1941-12-31), inclusive: the exemption runs through that day. The exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is the alternative. EO 8995, signed December 26, 1941, cites this order by number ("Executive Order No. 8610 of ") and exempts the same employee again: "I hereby further exempt" ... "for a period of one year ending December 31, 1942". It states no separate effective date, so its signature date is recorded as the event date. It is a later event, not an end: it is a new exemption for a later period and does not revoke, shorten or supersede the exemption in EO 8610.
